analysis_unit: generated-scene seed cluster; mean of two randomized whole-session repetitions per arm
limits: Fresh generated-scene seeds are not independent content families or physical network sources.
One local Chromium build, one loopback userspace relay, one generated scene algorithm, and one capacity schedule.
150 ms pixel-readback and sampled RGB PSNR are delivery/QoE proxies, not human QoE.
Offered relay wire bytes are a local transport-volume proxy; possible events include clock-boundary ambiguity.
No pooling with V3-V7, archived native sessions, recorded-video evidence, or simulator/synthetic-controller evidence.
The existing 0.85-BWE headroom rule was evaluated as a fixed baseline; no policy was fit or promoted.

turn_v2.failure_class: selected local peer-reflexive classification rejected after TURN-backed ICE connection

turn_v3.failure_class: phase-snapshot guard read an unrecorded remote_candidate_type field after the registered session schedule

turn_v4.failure_class: three sessions missed held-out clock coverage; eight sessions violated V4's registered zero-overflow queue rule

turn_v5.failure_class: two sessions missed held-out coverage at the initial high-phase marker m0002

turn_v6.failure_class: 21 sessions missed final held-out marker m0011 and two also missed m0003

runtime.network_policy: TURN control TCP and relay/queue UDP are loopback-only

transport.candidate_gathering_acceptance: Both peers complete gathering with only loopback relay candidates using relayProtocol=tcp and zero candidate errors.
transport.media_acceptance: Each scheduled phase has more than ten encoded and decoded frames and finite mean encode time.
transport.queue_acceptance: Both directions forward at least 100 packets from matching TURN allocation ports, no unexpected sources or send errors; packet and byte replay exactly matches offer/drop/service/forward ledgers; capacity and conservation checks pass.
transport.selected_pair_acceptance: Both pairs are nominated/succeeded and use TURN relay candidates over loopback with relayProtocol=tcp.
